notes: Memory totals include the entire STM32 application firmware, not only the planner.
Planner object, task stacks, and reserved FreeRTOS heap are already included in the RAM totals.
The standard build summary omits Flash vector/padding/libc bytes and RAM .nzds / ._usrstack reservations; ELF details include them.
Startup free heap is a single boot-time measurement; minimum-ever free heap is not exposed by this firmware.
Both TinySDP stack logs are zero because tsdp.run remained zero and no planning frames were executed. Stack headroom under load was not measured.
Flash success, readback of TinySDP parameters, and system.selftestPassed=1 were verified. The startup console reports Storage check [OK].

This report was migrated from .cf-container/deployments/tinysdp_ct/report.json; no build, flash, or hardware measurements were repeated. The original recorded_at was 2026-11-19T21:59:18.472962-05:00; it was normalized to seconds precision for the report naming convention.
Evidence: build.log, flash.log, and check.log are byte-for-byte copies of the original captured logs.

Commands used for the original deployment: ./cf-container build tinysdp_ct; ./cf-container flash tinysdp_ct radio://0/80/2M/E7E7E7E7E7. Read-only inspection used cflib SyncCrazyflie/SyncLogger with tsdp.run=0.

Runtime conditions: 20 telemetry samples at a 100 ms period, spanning 1900 ms; zero planning frames. Planner/setpoint stack margins were not exercised. Planner footprint and startup free heap were measured; minimum-ever free heap was unavailable.

Provenance recovery: the root revision and dirty state were recorded in the deployment session; firmware revision and modified state are corroborated by build.log and check.log. The documented firmware Makefile patch was applied before the build; crazyflie-firmware.patch records the matching diff recovered during migration.

Compiler identity was recovered from the existing ELF .comment section. The current binary SHA-256 still matches the original deployed image. build.config and app-config were recovered from the unchanged build inputs; the generated configuration and ELF retain their original build timestamps.

Historical provenance limitation: the deployment-time container image ID and a complete snapshot of untracked host tooling were not saved. source.container_image_id and source.untracked_inputs are null; no current environment identity is substituted for historical evidence.
